title: The wording of MSG-P8-001 and MSG-P8-002 is not in the read sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E4-048); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3.md A2.9
description: Both stories carry MSG-P8-001 (the run summary of a date with an unmatched receipt) and MSG-P8-002 (no payment_match_rule row in force on the business date) as message identifiers and no source in the read set gives their text; the legacy story lists only MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003, and the FSD names the two P8 identifiers without wording.
evidence: FSD P8 A2.9 prints neither message; the legacy story Validation and messages table holds MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003 only
proposed: Copy the two texts from the Error and Message Standard at the next read, keeping the identifiers unchanged

title: The rental read of rwb-treatment has no published operation name, path or field list
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3.md A2.9; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T5.2
description: The rental amount, the debit day and the due date that the rental arm matches against are rwb-treatment's facts, and no source in the read set gives the name, path or field list of the read that serves them; the story and the profile carry the placeholder and settle the shape with rwb-treatment before the build.
evidence: FSD P8 A2.9 names FEAT-TRT-16 as its prerequisite and ATS and AMIS as its integration points, and TSD P8 T5.2 names only the published Java interfaces of P3, P4, P5, P6 and P7
proposed: Publish the rental read in the S2 contract epic with the rental reference, the treatment reference, the case reference, the rental amount, the debit day and the due date

title: Four reads are consumed as class C while the plan's contract row is None, and the rental rule code is not named
source: WP B2-P8-005 story JSON (C []); _work/msr/context/P8.md; Template and Rules v1 R5.4 and R5.5
description: The rental arm consumes the rental read of rwb-treatment, the receipt read of rwb-source-data, the case answer of rwb-case and the package read of rwb-decision, each of them another service's contract, and the plan carries no C row for this key; the rule code and rule version of the rental match are rows of payment_match_rule and the code of the rental arm is named in no source.
evidence: The WP JSON gives C [] for both stories; FSD P8 A2.9 lists the rental read and the receipt read as prerequisites; TSD P8 T3.1 carries rule_code and rule_version as columns of payment_match_rule
proposed: Add the four C rows to the plan and name the rental match rule in the matching-rule story of P8, or keep them as consumed and faked until the owners publish

title: FSD P8 A2.9 names ATS and AMIS while TSD P8 T5.1 names ALS and GL only
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3.md A2.9.2; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T5.1
description: The functional specification places the auto-debit instruction with ATS and AMIS, and the technical specification of the same module lists only INT-02 and INT-03 to ALS and INT-16 to the GL. No source says which service owns the instruction, its file or message format and its frequency.
evidence: FSD P8 A2.9.2 Integration points: ATS, AMIS; TSD P8 T5.1: INT-02 ALS in, INT-03 ALS out, INT-16 GL in
proposed: Keep the instruction with FEAT-TRT-16 in rwb-treatment, which creates the rental record and sets the auto-debit under R-DIL-32, and let rwb-payment collect, match and follow up

title: The rental fields of the PaymentMissed and ProceedsMatched payloads are not published
source: _work/msr/context/P8.md (events EV-11, EV-12, EV-25); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T5.3
description: PaymentMissed is published with the example fields caseId, treatmentId, dueDate, amountDue and daysLate and ProceedsMatched with a consumer list only, so no source gives the rental reference, the business date, the debit day or the rule identity fields the rental arm must carry.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 22 gives the PaymentMissed example; TSD P8 T5.3 lists the three events with a direction and no payload
proposed: Publish the two payloads in the AsyncAPI fragment of the payment profile and register them in BACKWARD mode before the app story starts

title: Two contract stories of one service declare the same base surface
source: WP B2-P8-005 story JSON (CON of RWB-E4-048); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-SVC-P8 rwb-payment (Payment)/RWB P8 E4043 CON Match a settlement payment - contract v1.md
section: CON s1, s12.1, s19; APP s1
description: RWB-P8-E4043-CON already declares the two operations, the Proceeds element group and the three payment event schemas, and the plan gives this key its own CON story, so the split of members between the two documents has to be fixed or the second document duplicates the first.
evidence: RWB-P8-E4043-CON s12.1 and s12.3 declare GET /proceeds, POST /proceeds/{proceedsId}/match, TreatmentBooked, PaymentMissed and ProceedsMatched
proposed: Keep the base surface with RWB-P8-E4043-CON and let this profile declare the rental members, the rental constraints and the fakes as additive

title: LOV-MATCH holds no value that names a rental
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T3.2; RWB-E4-048 AC1
description: The rental receipt is a receipt matched to the rental installment of a deed in lieu arrangement, and the list in force holds INSTALLMENT, SETTLEMENT, FEE, SALE_PROCEEDS and UNMATCHED only. No source says which value a rental receipt takes, and a new value would change a closed list.
evidence: TSD P8 T3.2 LOV-MATCH: INSTALLMENT, SETTLEMENT, FEE, SALE_PROCEEDS, UNMATCHED
proposed: Match the rental receipt to INSTALLMENT unless the business owner adds a RENTAL value to LOV-MATCH with its version
